name: Victoria (a links-style course on the rocky point of Oak Bay)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Victoria Golf Club, Oak Bay, BC, from the Capital Regional District's 2025 orthophoto (summer): firm, slightly grey-green fairways and paler greens (the island's dry summers), a lean olive-khaki rough (F0-F2), bright white sand, the dark blue-grey Strait of Juan de Fuca, grey-brown rock outcrops (K tones) and the Oak Bay gardens out of bounds (L0-L2). Trees in assets-src/trees_victoria.py: Douglas fir, shore pine and Garry oak. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
